Description.SourceString:
As the god of chaos and rebellion, you’d expect Zamorak to discourage churches, yet hypocrisy is chaos too, so he’s always pleased to see a temple in his name. Especially one with expensive windows, carefully crafted sculptures and an adoring army of priests, chanting his name.

One must have an ego to be a god, and Zamorak has more followers than most.

The priests of the Cathedral spend their days and nights in quiet contemplation… well they did, before everything went wrong. Now they wander the rooms muttering to themselves and hurling deadly spells at anyone who approaches.

Zamorak enjoys all this chaos just as much.
